address: Avenida de Cánovas del Castillo 1, Malaga, 29016, Spain
bio: Located on the ground floor of the MS Maestranza hotel, conveniently located between the bullring and the ever-busy Muelle Uno. You'll find a contemporary menu, with a tapas option, which revisits dishes from the local gastronomy, such as its reinterpretation of the Ensalada Malagueña or the wild sea bass in miso and camomile gazpachuelo. Tip: Don't miss the cocktail that gives the restaurant its name, made with gin, red vermouth, banana liqueur, lime and angostura (with this cocktail, in 1967, the founder of the hotel chain was Spanish champion and runner-up in the World Cocktail Championship)....
